stem.text: Four students, **A**, **B**, **C** and **D**, observed plant epidermal cells that had been placed in a concentrated sucrose solution for 30 minutes. They were asked to identify the partially permeable layer and to explain the appearance of the cells in terms of water potential and movement of water.

A.text: cell surface membrane; cell contents have a lower water potential than the sucrose solution; water moved out of the cell and no water moved in

B.text: cell surface membrane; cell contents have a higher water potential than the sucrose solution; more water moved out of the cell than moved in

C.text: cell wall; cell contents have a lower water potential than the sucrose solution; more water moved out of the cell than moved in

D.text: cell wall; cell contents have a higher water potential than the sucrose solution; water moved out of the cell and no water moved in
